_doc: Lead-proven constant data: globals=fuzz:<kind> never overwrites addresses in these ranges (they keep their image values). Each entry needs evidence that no code writes the range.

ranges.evidence: Q14 cosine/sine table read as [reg*2+0x7c5c5c] by the core; a scan of every function's instructions (662,847) for memory-destination operands into 0x7c5c5c..0x7c9c5c found a single store, at 0x51cb62 to 0x7c8db0, which is above this range.

word table 0..15 twice (nibble k&0xf) initialised in the image; read by 0x55ad9b ([reg*2+0x88f572]) and nothing else, and a scan of every function's instructions finds no memory write with a displacement in 0x88f560..0x88f5c0 (L29 proposal, lead scan).

floor/divisor dword (image 0x100) read by 0x41804b, 0x41cde4, 0x41e069, 0x41c838; a scan of every function finds writes only to the neighbouring 0x602004/0x602008, none to 0x60200c (k151 report, lead scan). Fuzzing it to 0 made 0x41cde4 divide by zero at 0x41ceb6/0x41cf41.

shell-sort gap table (7 unaligned dwords 0x445,0x16c,0x79,0x28,0xd,4,1) read by 0x52f506; the only write anywhere near is 'mov byte [0x826e5f],0' at 0x52b3c8, just past the table (L35 proposal, lead scan).
max sub-step batch (image 4); no instruction anywhere writes it (lead scan); L34: the game's step domain depends on it

10-dword bit-mask table read as [reg*4+0x875d8c] by 0x5520a0/0x55218f (test only); every code reference within 0x40 bytes of the table is a read (test/movzx/and/or/mov reg), no immediate base for a block store (lead scan 2026-10-20; L46 scanned 612,795 instructions for stores).
